body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, learn each target's lowest Defense and make each Exposed until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Also learn which target has more remaining Reaction Dice.
Each hit target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Ambush
rider.html: When one chosen hit target gains an ordinary defensive benefit before your next turn, suppress 1 point of that benefit against the next attack before your next turn.
